THE PROBLEM

Hanoi is going digital.

Not everyone can keep up.

Digital payment works well for confident phone users. It leaves out people who aren’t.

Small screens, many apps

Payment apps are made for young, confident phone users.

No phone, no bank

Many children, and some older people, have neither.

Cash still matters

Lots of people still pay in cash and want to keep doing that.

Hanoi is going digital, but not everyone can keep up. Payment apps are made for young, confident phone users. Many children and some older people have no phone or bank account, and lots of people still pay in cash. So how do we go digital without leaving them behind? Over to Khánh. (Click, then pass the clicker.)
Thanks, Khang. This is Dana. The home screen has one big orange PAY button, with the balance and bills due above it, and a Listen button that reads the screen aloud. Press PAY and you get a QR ticket: hold it to the reader, or tap your phone.
The Wallet: top up, send and receive, your bus passes, and more services like bills, taxi and parking.
And the family wallet: one shared balance, a daily limit for children, and tap cards, so nobody needs a phone to ride.
And Settings: big text and a voice guide, on by default.

WHO WE DESIGN FOR

L

Bà Lan, 72

Persona · grandmother

SENIOR

Takes bus 52 to the market every morning.

Pays in cash. Small text on phones is hard for her to read.

Needs: big buttons, a voice that guides her, and a way to pay with no phone.

M

Minh, 13

Persona · student

STUDENT

Rides bus 19 to school.

Has no bank account. His family wants to know he got on the bus.

Needs: a card he can tap, a daily limit, and a message to his family.

We designed for two people: Bà Lan, 72, who pays in cash and struggles with small text, and Minh, 13, who has no bank account, and whose family wants to know he got on the bus.

HOW DANA FITS WITHCOMMUNITY’S NEEDS

So how does Dana fit?

ONE WALLET, THREE WAYS TO PAY

ONE WALLET

The same balance, however you pay

Lan · 245,000 ₫

Cash

Pay cash at a bus station counter or partner store. It goes onto the Dana card.

Card

Tap the Dana card on the bus reader. No phone, no charging.

App

Press one big PAY button and hold the code to the reader. It says “Paid” out loud.

Dana is one wallet with three ways in: cash at a counter, a card you tap, or the app’s one big button. It’s the same balance every time.

OUR GOALS

01

Provide a simple, easy-to-follow payment process with large buttons, clear text and voice guidance.

02

A physical card lets people pay without relying on a smartphone or advanced digital skills.

03

Instant receipts or text messages after each payment help people feel confident and secure.

Our three goals: a payment process anyone can follow, with big buttons and a voice; no smartphone required; and a receipt or message after every payment.

DESIGNED FOR GRANDPARENTS AND KIDS

One big PAY button on the home screen

A voice guide that reads each screen, on by default

Text size up to Largest, with strong contrast

Large buttons with words, not just icons

A family wallet with daily limits for kids

The design does all of that: one big button, a voice on by default, and big text.

    MORE THAN THE BUS

    Pay bills

    Electricity, water, internet and phone: one at a time, or all at once.

    More services

    Taxi, bike share, parking, phone top-up, hospital and school fees.

    Tap cards for family

    Lock a card, set a daily limit, get a message after every ride.

    Thanks, Khánh. Beyond the bus: pay bills in one tap, more services from the same wallet, and family tap cards you control from the app.

    HOW IT IS SUSTAINABLE

    Long-term sustainability through a simpler, faster and safer payment experience for everyone in Hanoi.

    Environmental

    Less paper and waste: digital receipts and reusable cards.

    Economic

    Faster service and flexible payment: cash, card or app.

    Social

    Easy payments for everyone, including older people and children.

    Why it lasts: less paper and waste, faster service with flexible payment, and easy payments for everyone. A simpler, faster and safer way to pay, for everyone in Hanoi.
